title: Land Settlement (Amendment)
long_title: AN ACT TO AMEND THE LAND SETTLEMENT ORDINANCE, TO PROVIDE FOR REVISION OR CANCELLATION OF SETTLEMENT ORDERS ; AND TO PROVIDE FOR MATTERS CONNECTED THEREWITH OR INCIDENTAL THERETO.

edition.caveat: private republisher, not the Government Printer

body.heading: Short title.
body.raw_text: 1. This Act may be cited as the Land Settlement (Amendment) Act, No. 23 of 1996.
body.text: This Act may be cited as the Land Settlement (Amendment) Act, No. 23 of 1996.

body.heading: Amendment of section 5 in Chapter 468.
body.raw_text: 2. The Land settlement Ordinance (hereinafter referred to as" the Principal enactment") is hereby amended by the insertion, immediately after subsection (7) of section 5 of thereof, of the following new subsection:- "
body.text: The Land settlement Ordinance (hereinafter referred to as" the Principal enactment") is hereby amended by the insertion, immediately after subsection (7) of section 5 of thereof, of the following new subsection:- "

children.raw_text: (a) a person makes a claim to any land specified in a settlement notice or to a share of, or interest in, any such land, at any time after the expiration of the period of three months specified in such notice and the further period, if any, prescribed by the proviso to subsection (1) section 5, but prior to the publication under section 8, of the order prescribed by subsection (5) of section 5, embodying the settlement of the land specified in the settlement notice or any share of, or interest in, such land; and
children.text: a person makes a claim to any land specified in a settlement notice or to a share of, or interest in, any such land, at any time after the expiration of the period of three months specified in such notice and the further period, if any, prescribed by the proviso to subsection (1) section 5, but prior to the publication under section 8, of the order prescribed by subsection (5) of section 5, embodying the settlement of the land specified in the settlement notice or any share of, or interest in, such land; and

children.raw_text: (b) the Settlement officer is satisfied that the claimant had reasonable grounds for failing to make such claim within such period of three months and such further period if any,
children.text: the Settlement officer is satisfied that the claimant had reasonable grounds for failing to make such claim within such period of three months and such further period if any,

children.raw_text: the settlement officer may, notwithstanding anything in this Ordinance, entertain, and deal with such claim as though it had been made within time, and in such case, it shall be lawful for the settlement officer for the purpose of dealing with such claim to declare, after hearing the other claimants, any declaration made by him under subsection (1) or (4) of section 5 or any agreement entered into by him under subsection (4) of section 5 to be null and void.''.

body.heading: Insertion of section 5A in the principal enactment.
body.raw_text: 3. The following new section is Inserted immediately after section 5 of the principal enactment, and shall have effect as section 5A thereof:- "Power of settlement officer to declare declaration or agreement null and void.
body.text: The following new section is Inserted immediately after section 5 of the principal enactment, and shall have effect as section 5A thereof:
body.heading_moved_to: Power of settlement officer to declare declaration or agreement null and void.

provision.heading: Power of settlement officer to declare declaration or agreement null and void.
provision.raw_text: 5A. Where a settlement officer who has made a declaration under subsection (1) or (4) of section 5, or entered Into an agreement under subsection (4) of section 5, for respect of a land specified In a settlement notice or to any share of, or interest to, any' such land, has reasonable grounds to doubt the authenticity of any document, or the veracity of any evidence, produced before him at any inquiry preceding the making declaration or the entering into of such agreement, he may, at any time prior to the publication under section 8, of the order prescribed by subsection (5) of section summon every claimant to the land specified in such settlement notice or to any share of or interest in, such land to appear before him and to produce the evidence upon which such claimant relies in proof of his claim and shall make fresh inquiry into such claimant and after such Inquiry it shall be lawful for the settlement officer for the purpose of dealing with such claim, to declare the declaration made by him under subsection (1) or subsection (4) of section 5 or the agreement entered into by him under subsection (4) of section 5, as the case may be, to be null and void.".
provision.text: Where a settlement officer who has made a declaration under subsection (1) or (4) of section 5, or entered Into an agreement under subsection (4) of section 5, for respect of a land specified In a settlement notice or to any share of, or interest to, any' such land, has reasonable grounds to doubt the authenticity of any document, or the veracity of any evidence, produced before him at any inquiry preceding the making declaration or the entering into of such agreement, he may, at any time prior to the publication under section 8, of the order prescribed by subsection (5) of section summon every claimant to the land specified in such settlement notice or to any share of or interest in, such land to appear before him and to produce the evidence upon which such claimant relies in proof of his claim and shall make fresh inquiry into such claimant and after such Inquiry it shall be lawful for the settlement officer for the purpose of dealing with such claim, to declare the declaration made by him under subsection (1) or subsection (4) of section 5 or the agreement entered into by him under subsection (4) of section 5, as the case may be, to be null and void.".

body.heading: Sinhala text to prevail in case of inconsistency.
body.raw_text: 4. In the event of any inconsistency between the sinhala and Tamil texts of this Act, the Sinhala text shall prevail.
body.text: In the event of any inconsistency between the sinhala and Tamil texts of this Act, the Sinhala text shall prevail.

Section 2 amends section 5 of the principal enactment and section 3 inserts section 5A: the validator's 'beyond last section' warnings on 5 and 5A are references into the Land Settlement Ordinance, not into this four-section Act.

Section 3: the HTML page carries the full text of the inserted section 5A ('Power of settlement officer to declare declaration or agreement null and void. 5A. Where a settlement officer who has made a declaration ...'), but the parser kept only the lead-in sentence and dropped the quoted body. The inserted wording is held in the consolidated tree at section 5A (marker '[ 3,23 of 1996]'), where it matches the amending Act's HTML. Not transcribed here by hand; recorded as a parser defect.

Section 2 heading reads 'Amendment of section 5 in Chapter 468.' as printed; Cap. 468 is the chapter number LankaLaw prints for this Act's principal enactment, while the consolidated PDF of the principal Ordinance is headed Cap. 299. The two chapter numbers come from different revised editions; not reconciled here.
